bullets.text: Leading development of an Aeronautical Information GIS Platform (Django, PostGIS, GeoServer), full SDLC.
Designed and implemented backend architecture using Django, PostGIS, and GeoServer to deliver reliable, standards-compliant geospatial services.
Integrated heterogeneous spatial and non-spatial datasets and ensured data integrity across internal platforms.
Automated geospatial validation and processing workflows, improving data reliability and reducing manual errors.
Translated Francophone AIP datasets (Senegal, Mali, Congo-Brazzaville) into English, ensuring cross-language data consistency.
Created market intelligence maps in ArcGIS Pro to identify customer hotspots, enabling data-driven outreach.
Mentored junior staff on GIS data standards and system development practices.
